Troubleshooting · 08/50 · scheduling

Call sheet timezone mismatch

Failure signal

A call sheet timezone mismatch condition is reported or detected during scheduling.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for scheduling does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare call times, transport and sunrise data in the location timezone.

Corrective action

Regenerate the sheet with explicit timezone labels and acknowledge the correction.

Prevention

Add this verification to the scheduling gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
